notes.title: From Chaos: Massive Update Coming + AMA
notes.notes:
Greetings Aeterneans! 

We will be holding an AMA at [b]2 PM EST on June 22, 2024[/b] in our Discord to go over some exciting updates on the progress of Abyss Online and gather community feedback for our roadmap! Over the last three weeks, our team has made significant strides in several key areas:

[b]Character and World Saving Systems:[/b] We are refining our character and world save system.

[b]Server Infrastructure:[/b] We now have a sharding system, all servers will be combined into one world. 

[b]User Interface:[/b] Entire UI has been completely revamped, windows can now be opened individually and moved. There is now a fully functioning settings menu and hotkey reassignment.

[b]Animation Systems:[/b] Rebuilt from the ground up for multiplayer optimization.

[b]Auto Attacks:[/b] Ranged weapons, magic weapons, and melee weapons now have a more modern attack system for stamina based attcks. 

[b]Character Creator:[/b] 

[b]Weapons and Armor Systems:[/b] Undergoing a complete rework.

[b]Skills and Particle Effects:[/b] Major overhaul in progress, we have completely revamped the skill system to feel more “snappy” and we have heavily optimized every skill. Undergoing a complete rework, 

[b]World Map:[/b] Points of interest are being added in the beginner zone. We’re also working on a proper starter quest for this area. 

[b]Mobs:[/b] Mobs will properly attack and cast spells as intended. 

[b]Resources:[/b] Resources have been completely overhauled to optimize the game world.

[b]Progression Systems:[/b] We are revisiting our progression system based on player feedback. We require more community input on progression.

[b]Points of Interest being populated include:[/b]
- Small Starter City
- PvP Arena
- Gryphon's Nest
- Troll Cave
- Improved Orc Pit
- Improved Dragon's Roost
- Bandit's Lair
- Graveyard
- At least two secret locations

The above is an extensive amount of work, we are converting the majority of our Unreal Engine code from blueprints into C++ to optimize the game. 

This will be available to players later this year.

Thank you all for your unwavering support on this journey!

The Abyss Online Team

notes.title: Abyss Q1 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]🌠 Dear Adventurers of Aeternea, 🌠[/h2]

As we navigate through the early days of March 2024, the journey of Abyss Online has reached new heights, thanks to your unwavering support and enthusiasm. Here's a glance at the milestones we've achieved together and what lies ahead:

[h3]🛠️ Tech and Game Development Achievements:[/h3]
[b]Successful Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.3:[/b] Our transition to UE 5.3 has been a game-changer, resolving previous challenges and unlocking new possibilities for Abyss Online. The engine upgrade has significantly enhanced game performance and visual fidelity.

If you are interested in pre-purchasing the game, hop in Discord, ping a moderator and come test with us before you buy! The servers will be online a lot leading up to Early Access and you feedback is invaluable. If you are in the media and are interested in giving out Steam keys, please email nick@abyssonline.com

[h3]Taipei Game Show Success:[/h3] Our presence at the Taipei Game Show in January was a resounding success! We connected with many of you, shared insights about the game's future, and celebrated with exclusive Abyss collectibles.

[h3]Expanded Testing Platforms:[/h3] We've broadened our testing horizons beyond PC to include Mac, with Mobile and Console platforms later this year. This expansion ensures that more adventurers can explore Aeternea, regardless of their preferred gaming device.

[h3]Early Access Launch Set for April 18th:[/h3] Our journey through Alpha testing has paved the way for an Early Access, we are shipping a constant Stream of updates headed towards our full release later this year.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/30eea14a8c875f5b44ae1a7cce177cb6563612a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/97c7763cd22eea47f36d1ac99ab99f04197ddda1.png[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/e68846f238d7d4cb25d0c979e308437e3017f009.png[/img]

[h3]🌐 Website and Community Engagement:[/h3]
[b]Website Revamp Complete:[/b] Thanks to the incredible talent within our community  our website has undergone a significant transformation. It's now better equipped to serve as the central hub for all things Abyss Online. A community member named Enjie provided the service through his company. If you are interested in a similar site please reach out to him [url=https://www.webvise.io]here[/url]!

[url=https://www.abyssonline.com]Visit Our Website[/url]

[h3]Price Update and Early Access Pricing:[/h3] We've transitioned to our Early Access pricing of $24.95. We are not going to require a mandatory subscription going forward, we will offer an optional subscription later this year for reduced taxes and fast travel fees. 

[h3]Server Tests and Optimization:[/h3] Our recent server tests have been instrumental in optimizing performance, leading to an enhanced starter map that addresses FPS and GPU load issues.

[h3]🎮 Gameplay and Content Updates:[/h3]
[b]Overhaul and Closed Testing Feedback:[/b] Since our last playtest in November, Abyss has undergone a monumental transformation. Every aspect, from animations and particle effects to procedural generation and loot systems, has been refined for Early Access. We are nearly ready to test maps that can host up to 200 players. Please sign up [url=https://forms.gle/9RyaJWCrPG9RbFgT9]here[/url]

[h3]Community-Driven Development:[/h3] Your feedback has been vital. The test center is online, streaming the client and gathering invaluable insights. This collaborative effort is shaping Abyss into a game we all can be proud of.

[h3]🌟 A Look Forward:[/h3]
The path we're on is filled with promise and potential, thanks to your partnership and passion. As we edge closer to Early Access, the adventure within Aeternea grows ever more exciting. Your contributions, whether through feedback, testing, or simply sharing in our collective excitement, are what make this journey so extraordinary.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being an integral part of the Abyss Online community. Here's to forging ahead into a year of unparalleled adventure and discovery in the world of Aeternea!

With deepest gratitude,

The Abyss Team 🐉

notes.title: Abyss October Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Abyss Pre-orders[/h1]

Greetings Aeterneans! We have an exciting pre-order opportunity for you. For a limited time, you can pre-order Abyss for just $10 and save up to 75%! This is the lowest price Abyss will ever be, so grab it while you can.

Abyss is now regionally priced so it’s even more affordable for players around the world. We want as many people as possible to experience the magic of Abyss this holiday season.

Pre-ordering now grants you exclusive access to upcoming alpha tests and bonuses like emotes, skins, and more depending on which Pre-order Pack you choose. The $25 pack gets you an emote and the $50 pack gets you an emote and a unique skin. 

These exclusive items will never be available again, so claim them while you can!

Join our Discord to connect with the dev team and provide feedback that helps us iterate quickly.

[b]Performance Optimizations[/b]

We continue to optimize our environments and test them on an array of devices.
As we add biomes, we are seeing performance issues and we are working through them.

[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Asian Themed Biome & Armors
[*] Orc Biome & Armors
[*] Troll Biome & Armors
[*] Animated Loot Systems
[/list]

[b]Content Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] We have begun populating towns with decorations and NPCs
[*] Players are beginning to submit maps and we welcome you to do the same!
[/list]

We welcome your constructive feedback which helps us iterate quickly. Please join our Discord where you can connect directly with our development team.

The Abyss team hosted a popular exhibit at Gamescom Singapore and have plans to repeat live demos and AMAs with gamers around the world in Taipei in January! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/79a3101dbd18d84b8ccbff1261147776cf0e7045.jpg[/img]

We deployed 5.2 updates and added Unreal Nanite and Metahuman support. Other game features added include upgraded mining, woodcutting, crafting systems.  

Trolls, orcs, and goblins that function as mobs in the game. Soon they will function as playable races.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/496aae957d8bfafb2c72508dfd153605a3114ec0.gif[/img]

Check our socials for lots of new gameplay videos and get ready to test our new UE 5.2 build as we allow more players access to it!
